headline_summary: 5/5 Solana AMM protocols reject retail 10-20U 2000 USD LP; cumulative 28560 EV cells; best cell $0.544 only in zero_il_lvr (Meteora DLMM memecoin 100bps, 2000 USD, 7d); all other scenarios negative.

reasons.title: Not because connector did not work
reasons.detail: 5 stages connector_status = complete; SDK decode + quote path proven on public RPC.

reasons.title: Most connectors DID work
reasons.detail: Meteora DLMM (56 decode), Orca (75), Raydium CLMM (65), Raydium CPMM (81), Solana stable (25); 4 mainnet programs verified executable.

reasons.title: Realistic EV does not hold
reasons.detail: Across 28560 cells, 1898 positive in zero_il_lvr only, 0 in optimistic/realistic/conservative. Any IL > 0 makes all cells negative.

reasons.title: zero_il_lvr positive is not real positive
reasons.detail: zero_il_lvr is theoretical upper bound; V3 CL tick boundary crossing, constant product any price change, LST depeg all ensure IL > 0 in practice.

reasons.title: 10/20U small capital cannot cover fixed cost / slippage / IL
reasons.detail: 10 USD notional at 25bps × 0.5%/day = $0.00125/day gross; 7d gross $0.00875 minus cost $0.006 minus IL $0.35 = net -$0.347. Small capital means fee capture too small, fixed cost too large a ratio. Structural, not fee rate problem.

reasons.title: 100-2000U scale-up does not produce realistic positive
reasons.detail: At 2000 USD notional / 7d / zero_il_lvr: Meteora +$0.544, Orca +$0.106, Raydium CLMM +$0.167, Raydium CPMM +$0.172, Solana stable +$0.204. All < $0.55 best case. Scaling up notional does not solve IL dominance.

reasons.title: No pool satisfies probe preflight
reasons.detail: Per spec rule_1 trigger: positive_realistic > 0 OR strong near-break-even high-fee pool. 5/5 reject — none qualify.

reasons.title: Continued auto-expansion is low-value repetition
reasons.detail: All 5 mainnet Solana AMM protocols (DLMM, V3 CL x 3, CPMM, stable) tested. Remaining candidates: Meteora DAMM v2 stable (API mislabel, 0 verified), Lifinity (pid unknown), Mercurial (deprecated), Saber (rebranded, 0 active), native Curve on Solana (not exist). Marginal information value of further expansion is low.

reasons.title: Therefore STOP_LP_RESEARCH_NOW
reasons.detail: 5/5 reject cumulative + above 8 reasons = stable conclusion: in current data, current capital size, current automation model, retail 10-20U 2000 USD LP cannot achieve realistic positive EV on Solana.

caveat: STOP_LP_RESEARCH_NOW is research-only decision; does NOT affect project code, connectors, docs, tests, or safety gates which all remain intact and reusable.
